title: pstack public export: git push fallback when the REST write path is blocked

steps.title: reproduce
steps.note: Cloud session: REST read 401 without proxy env; with NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 read ok but write 403 (proxy blocks contents API writes); git push to telemetry/pstack succeeded

steps.title: fix
steps.note: Exporter: git push transport (auto fallback on REST 401/403, or PSTACK_PUBLISH_TRANSPORT=git); shared nextIndex; live wrapper no longer requires a token

steps.title: test
steps.note: node --test pstack tests: 11 pass, incl. git transport against a local bare remote
